name: Drakes
accommodation: 20 bedrooms in Good to Best categories, some with sea views or balconies; minimum two nights on Saturdays
suitableFor: Couples wanting a stylish seafront stay with a restaurant and bar on site
parking: On-site parking, charged per night (Visit Brighton listing)
beachAccess: Directly on the seafront on Marine Parade, about 0.22 miles from Palace Pier
confirmedFeatures: Cocktail bar, Dilsk restaurant, breakfast in restaurant or room, air conditioning, Wi-Fi, 24-hour staff, sea-view rooms
overview: Drakes occupies a pair of Regency townhouses on Marine Parade, right on Brighton seafront in Kemptown. Its 20 rooms run from compact doubles to sea-view rooms with balconies, and there is a cocktail bar and the Dilsk restaurant downstairs. Palace Pier is roughly a quarter of a mile along the front.
surfTripFit: Front-facing rooms look straight onto the sea, so you can check conditions from the window, and it accepts dogs and has parking on site.
